Generate the skeleton, don't hand-write it: `kubectl -n dojo-ckad run pair --image=busybox:1.36 --dry-run=client -o yaml -- sh -c 'while true; do date >> /data/out.log; sleep 2; done' > pair.yaml`, then edit.
An emptyDir goes under `spec.volumes: [{ name: shared, emptyDir: {} }]`; each container needs a matching `volumeMounts: [{ name: shared, mountPath: /data }]`.
Add the second container under `spec.containers` (it's a list). Give the reader a command like `sh -c 'sleep 5; tail -f /data/out.log'` so it doesn't exit and CrashLoop.
